recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
capital: Podgorica · Cetinje retains the status of "Old Royal Capital"
rulers: President Jakov MILATOVIC (since 20 May 2023); Prime Minister Milojko SPAJIC (since 31 October 2023)
economy: upper-middle-income, small Balkan economy; uses euro as de facto currency; reduced growth due to slowdown in tourism and industrial production; new impetus for EU accession under Europe Now government; energy price cap and declining food and services prices easing inflation rate GDP (PPP): $17.375 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Army of Montenegro (Vojska Crne Gore or VCG): Ground Forces, Air Force, Navy Ministry of Interior: Police Directorate of Montenegro (2025) Expenditure: 2% of GDP (2025 est.)
origin: 3 June 2006 (from the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro); notable earlier dates: 13 March 1852 (Principality of Montenegro established); 13 July 1878 (Congress of Berlin recognizes Montenegrin independence); 28 August 1910 (Kingdom of Montenegro established)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
